ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde Trust & Safety for human review: preserve the in-app chat transcript (18:21:40 driver "Please do not smoke in the car."; 18:22:20 rider "Say that again and I will punch you.") as the record of an alleged threat against the driver; contact the driver to offer support and confirm he is unharmed; apply the Code of Conduct process for threats/intimidation (warn/suspend the rider account per SAFE-1) and advise the driver of the RydeHELP report path and, if he wishes to pursue the matter, the police report option. No fare adjustment is to be made in this ticket.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and the in-app chat contains a threat of physical violence: rider wrote "Say that again and I will punch you." (2026-10-17T18:22:20+08:00) after the driver asked him not to smoke (18:21:40). Per SAFE-1 no automatic ruling is issued; the matter goes to a human reviewer with the factual summary above (trip T-2045, RydeTAXI, Tampines Mall → Changi Airport T3, 18:09–18:28, fare SGD 21.26, no cancellation/waiting/toll charges).
